title: meanwhile — linear

sentences.sentence: The flight will be announced soon. Meanwhile, please remain seated.
sentences.translation: 很快就要广播通知登机，在此期间请继续留在座位上。

sentences.sentence: I knew I wouldn’t get my exam results for several weeks, and I wasn’t sure what to do in the meanwhile.
sentences.translation: 我知道我要几星期后才能拿到考试成绩，我不知道这期间该做什么。

sentences.sentence: a country ravaged by civil war
sentences.translation: 遭受内战重创的国家

sentences.sentence: His health was gradually ravaged by drink and drugs.
sentences.translation: 酗酒和吸毒渐渐毁了他的健康。

sentences.translation: 我初到伦敦求学时，他们待我如同朋友。

sentences.translation: 事实证明美国宪法能适应政治形势的变化。

sentences.translation: 这两条河在匹兹堡附近汇合。

sentences.translation: 我有幸与一位出色的部门主管共事。

sentences.sentence: Sickness or ill fortune could reduce you to a needy situation.
sentences.translation: 疾病或厄运会让你穷困潦倒。

sentences.sentence: I felt it was useless to struggle against fortune.
sentences.translation: 我觉得跟命运抗争是徒劳的。

sentences.sentence: Besides this, Javert possessed in his eye the feline phosphorescence of night birds.
sentences.translation: 况且沙威的眼睛有着夜鸟那种象猫一样的磷光。

sentences.sentence: Whilst all the landscape was in neutral shade his companion's face, which was the focus of his eyes, rising above the mist stratum, seemed to have a sort of phosphorescence upon it.
sentences.translation: 当所有的景物都沐浴在明暗相宜的色调中的时候，他的同伴的脸就成了他眼睛注意的中心，那张脸从层层雾霭中显露出来，脸上似乎染上了一层磷光。

sentences.sentence: Crystal habit, luster, color, streak, cleavage, fracture, fluorescence, phosphorescence, specific gravity and magnetism.
sentences.translation: 晶体习性、光泽、颜色、条痕、解理、裂理、荧光、磷光、比重和磁性。

sentences.sentence: She improved visibly from day to day, until Martin wondered if he was doing right, for he knew that all her compliance and endeavor was for his sake.
sentences.translation: 她一天比一天进步了，直到马丁怀疑起自己的做法是否得体。 因为他明白她的这一切迁就和努力都是为了他。

sentences.sentence: The energy, the faith, the devotion which we bring to this endeavor will light our country and all who serve it -- and the glow from that fire can truly light the world.
sentences.translation: 我们在这场努力中所献出的精力、信念与虔诚、将照亮我们的国家以及所有为国家服务的人，而从这一火焰所聚出的光辉必能照明全世界。

sentences.sentence: We cannot succeed in this endeavor alone, but we can lead it.
sentences.translation: 我们不可能独自完成这项努力，但我们可以发挥带头作用。

translations.translation: 葡萄牙(欧洲西南部国家)

sentences.sentence: Spain is bounded on the east by Portugal.
sentences.translation: 西班牙的东面与葡萄牙接壤。

sentences.sentence: Ireland, Portugal and Greece have all required rescues.
sentences.translation: 爱尔兰，葡萄牙和希腊都需要救助。

sentences.sentence: ''Yes, he is only 33, but I think we should look at him just as a man on his own, a different manager - yes from Portugal, but a different individual, and just give him a chance to succeed.
sentences.translation: 确实，他只有33岁，但是我认为他应该看到他自我的一面，是一名不同于别人（穆里尼奥）的教练——虽然也来自葡萄牙，但是拥有不同的风格。 只有认识到这一点他才可能成功。

sentences.sentence: Drive safely!
sentences.translation: 安全行驶！

sentences.sentence: I think we can safely assume that she will pass the exam.
sentences.translation: 我想我们可以确信她会通过考试。

translations.translation: 看不见地, 看不出地

sentences.translation: 道路能见度因浓雾降至20米。

sentences.sentence: Critics love to generalize, to formulate trends into which all new work must be fitted, however contradictory.
sentences.translation: 评论家喜欢概括，归纳出所有新作品都必须符合的趋势，不管它们是如何地不符。

sentences.sentence: They levied religious taxes on Christian commercial transactions.
sentences.translation: 他们对基督教的商业交易征收宗教税。

sentences.sentence: rye bread

sentences.sentence: an unpopular teacher
sentences.translation: 不受欢迎的老师

sentences.sentence: And, this is a really clever reaction because titanium tetrachloride is a gas.
sentences.translation: 这是一个非常巧妙的反应,因为四氯化钛是一种气体。

sentences.sentence: But for those patients who do worry about the prospect of going in for elbow surgery and coming out with a titanium hip, the final line of defense may be the most powerful: speak up.
sentences.translation: 但是对于那些确实担心为肘关节做手术结果却是换了个钛合金髋关节这一情况发生的病人，最终的防卫线或许是最有力的：大声说出来。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 252 单元

meanwhile
音标：英 /'miːnwaɪl/  美 /'minwaɪl/
adv. 其间
短语：in the meanwhile — 同时；在此期间
例句：The flight will be announced soon. Meanwhile, please remain seated.
很快就要广播通知登机，在此期间请继续留在座位上。
例句：I knew I wouldn’t get my exam results for several weeks, and I wasn’t sure what to do in the meanwhile.
我知道我要几星期后才能拿到考试成绩，我不知道这期间该做什么。

ravage
音标：英 /'rævɪdʒ/  美 /'rævɪdʒ/
n&v. 毁坏
例句：a country ravaged by civil war
遭受内战重创的国家
例句：His health was gradually ravaged by drink and drugs.
酗酒和吸毒渐渐毁了他的健康。

befriend
音标：英 /bɪ'frend/  美 /bi'frend/
v. 待人如友,帮助
例句：They befriended me when I first arrived in London as a student.
我初到伦敦求学时，他们待我如同朋友。

adaptable
音标：英 /ə'dæptəb(ə)l/  美 /ə'dæptəbl/
adj. 能适应的,适应性强的
例句：The American Constitution has proved adaptable in changing political conditions.
事实证明美国宪法能适应政治形势的变化。

converge
音标：英 /kən'vɜːdʒ/  美 /kən'vɝdʒ/
v. 聚合, 集中
例句：The two rivers converge into one near Pittsburgh.
这两条河在匹兹堡附近汇合。

fortune
音标：英 /'fɔːtʃuːn; -tʃ(ə)n/  美 /'fɔrtʃən/
n. 财富, 运气
短语：good fortune — 好财运，好运；顺景
短语：make a fortune — 发财，赚大钱
短语：a small fortune — [口，谑]一笔巨款；很多钱
短语：fame and fortune — 名声与财富
短语：fortune magazine — 财富杂志
短语：make one's fortune — ◎发财
短语：fortune teller — 算命先生；预言家
短语：wheel of fortune — 幸运轮，轮盘赌
短语：by good fortune — 幸而
短语：fortune cookie — 签饼；福饼
短语：seek one's fortune — 寻找发迹的机会；寻出路
短语：reversal of fortune — 命运的逆转
短语：cost a fortune — 花大价钱；价格很高；值一大笔钱
例句：I had the good fortune to work with a brilliant head of department.
我有幸与一位出色的部门主管共事。
例句：Sickness or ill fortune could reduce you to a needy situation.
疾病或厄运会让你穷困潦倒。
例句：I felt it was useless to struggle against fortune.
我觉得跟命运抗争是徒劳的。

phosphorescence
音标：英 /,fɒsfə'res(ə)ns/  美 /,fɑsfə'rɛsns/
n. 磷光
例句：Besides this, Javert possessed in his eye the feline phosphorescence of night birds.
况且沙威的眼睛有着夜鸟那种象猫一样的磷光。
例句：Whilst all the landscape was in neutral shade his companion's face, which was the focus of his eyes, rising above the mist stratum, seemed to have a sort of phosphorescence upon it.
当所有的景物都沐浴在明暗相宜的色调中的时候，他的同伴的脸就成了他眼睛注意的中心，那张脸从层层雾霭中显露出来，脸上似乎染上了一层磷光。
例句：Crystal habit, luster, color, streak, cleavage, fracture, fluorescence, phosphorescence, specific gravity and magnetism.
晶体习性、光泽、颜色、条痕、解理、裂理、荧光、磷光、比重和磁性。

endeavor
音标：英 /ɪn'devə/  美 /ɪn'dɛvɚ/
n&v. 尽力, 努力
例句：She improved visibly from day to day, until Martin wondered if he was doing right, for he knew that all her compliance and endeavor was for his sake.
她一天比一天进步了，直到马丁怀疑起自己的做法是否得体。 因为他明白她的这一切迁就和努力都是为了他。
例句：The energy, the faith, the devotion which we bring to this endeavor will light our country and all who serve it -- and the glow from that fire can truly light the world.
我们在这场努力中所献出的精力、信念与虔诚、将照亮我们的国家以及所有为国家服务的人，而从这一火焰所聚出的光辉必能照明全世界。
例句：We cannot succeed in this endeavor alone, but we can lead it.
我们不可能独自完成这项努力，但我们可以发挥带头作用。

supervisor
音标：英 /'suːpəvaɪzə; 'sjuː/  美 /'supɚvaɪzɚ/
n. 管理人；监督人
短语：production supervisor — 生产主管
短语：warehouse supervisor — 仓库主管；仓库管理人
短语：sales supervisor — 销售主管；销售监管；销售主任
短语：project supervisor — 项目主管
短语：accounting supervisor — 会计主管；财务主管
短语：safety supervisor — 安全监督员；安全督导员
短语：operation supervisor — 操作管理程序，操作主管人
短语：supervisor mode — 管态，管理方式；监督模态
短语：purchasing supervisor — 采购主管
例句：...a full-time job as a supervisor at a factory.
…在一家工厂担任监督员的一项全职工作。

Portugal
音标：英 /ˈpɔːtjʊɡəl/  美 /'pɔtjuɡəl/
n. 葡萄牙(欧洲西南部国家)
例句：Spain is bounded on the east by Portugal.
西班牙的东面与葡萄牙接壤。
例句：Ireland, Portugal and Greece have all required rescues.
爱尔兰，葡萄牙和希腊都需要救助。
例句：''Yes, he is only 33, but I think we should look at him just as a man on his own, a different manager - yes from Portugal, but a different individual, and just give him a chance to succeed.
确实，他只有33岁，但是我认为他应该看到他自我的一面，是一名不同于别人（穆里尼奥）的教练——虽然也来自葡萄牙，但是拥有不同的风格。 只有认识到这一点他才可能成功。

safely
音标：英 /'seɪflɪ/  美 /'sefli/
adv. 安全地, 确实地
例句：Drive safely!
安全行驶！
例句：I think we can safely assume that she will pass the exam.
我想我们可以确信她会通过考试。

invisibly
adv. 看不见地, 看不出地

visibility
音标：英 /vɪzɪ'bɪlɪtɪ/  美 /'vɪzə'bɪləti/
n. 可见度
短语：low visibility — 低能见度
短语：poor visibility — 不良能见度；能见度不良；较差能见度
短语：visibility meter — 能见度表
例句：Visibility on the roads is down to 20 metres due to heavy fog.
道路能见度因浓雾降至20米。

generalize
音标：英 /ˈdʒɛnrəˌlaɪz/  美 /'dʒɛnrəlaɪz/
v. 归纳, 概括
例句：Critics love to generalize, to formulate trends into which all new work must be fitted, however contradictory.
评论家喜欢概括，归纳出所有新作品都必须符合的趋势，不管它们是如何地不符。

levy
音标：英 /'levɪ/  美 /'lɛvi/
v. 征收(税等) n征税
短语：tax levy — 纳税；征收税款
短语：levy on — 征税；扣押
短语：levy tax — 征税
短语：transaction levy — 交易征费
例句：They levied religious taxes on Christian commercial transactions.
他们对基督教的商业交易征收宗教税。

rye
音标：英 /raɪ/  美 /raɪ/
n. 裸麦
短语：rye bread — 黑面包
短语：rye flour — 黑麦粉；裸麦粉
例句：rye bread
黑麦面包

unpopular
音标：英 /ʌn'pɒpjʊlə/  美 /ʌn'pɑpjəlɚ/
adj. 不流行的, 不受欢迎的
例句：an unpopular choice
不得人心的选择
例句：an unpopular teacher
不受欢迎的老师

holocene
音标：美 /'hɔləsi:n/
n&a. [地]全新世(的)
短语：holocene epoch — 全新世

titanium
音标：英 /taɪ'teɪnɪəm; tɪ-/  美 /taɪ'tenɪəm; tɪ-/
n. [化]钛
短语：titanium alloy — 钛合金
短语：titanium dioxide — 二氧化钛
短语：titanium white — 钛白
短语：titanium oxide — 三氧化钛
短语：titanium pigment — 钛白粉；钛颜料
短语：titanium sponge — 海绵钛
短语：titanium tetrachloride — 四氯化钛
短语：sponge titanium — 海绵钛
短语：titanium nitride — 氮化钛
短语：titanium sulfate — n. 硫酸钛
短语：titanium carbide — 碳化钡
短语：titanium steel — 钛钢

这是一个非常巧妙的反应,因为四氯化钛是一种气体。
例句：But for those patients who do worry about the prospect of going in for elbow surgery and coming out with a titanium hip, the final line of defense may be the most powerful: speak up.

他们能显示出月球钛和铁储量的丰富储量和其土壤的成熟度。

linear

短语：linear velocity — 线速度
